modules.title: Carry-on
modules.lede: You can bring 1 personal item and 1 carry-on bag on board if they meet the size requirements.

carryon_bag_dimensions.value: 1 carry-on bag, no larger than 22 x 14 x 9 inches (56 x 36 x 23 cm) including handles and wheels; it must fit in the overhead bin or under the seat in front of you.

personal_item.value: 1 personal item, such as a purse or small handbag, no larger than 18 x 14 x 8 inches (45 x 35 x 20 cm); it must fit under the seat in front of you.

regional_valet.value: On regional American Eagle flights, a carry-on larger than the personal-item size must be valet-checked at the gate at no charge; Embraer ERJ-175 planes allow carry-on bags and have no valet service
regional_valet.notes: Carry-on page, regional flights paragraph and its footnote: "*Embraer ERJ-175 planes allow carry-on bags and don't offer valet service."

modules.title: Checked baggage
modules.lede: Bag fees are charged per person, each direction. Allowances depend on route, cabin and AAdvantage or oneworld status.

checked_bag_fees.value: Within/between the U.S., Puerto Rico, U.S. Virgin Islands, Canada, Caribbean (except Cuba / Haiti), Mexico, Central America (except Panama) and Guyana: 1st checked bag $50 ($45 if you pay online), 2nd checked bag $60 ($55 if you pay online). Basic Economy pays $5 more for the 1st and 2nd bags.
checked_bag_fees.notes: Checked bag policy page, re-read 2026-10-05. Main Cabin fees apply to tickets issued on or after April 9, 2026; the Basic Economy fees ($55 / $65, $50 / $60 online) to tickets issued on or after May 18, 2026.

size_weight.value: Each bag up to 62 in / 158 cm (length + width + height) and 50 lbs / 23 kgs. First / Business free bags may weigh up to 70 lbs / 32 kgs. On flights to / from Australia or New Zealand, free bags may weigh up to 70 lbs / 32 kgs.

premium_cabin_allowance.value: First 2 checked bags are free for confirmed Domestic First, Business and Premium Economy customers; first 3 are free for confirmed Flagship First and Flagship Business Plus customers.

free_first_bag_routes.value: The first checked bag is free on trips to destinations including Australia, New Zealand, Japan, China, Hong Kong, India, Qatar, South Korea and Trans-Atlantic routes. Basic Economy is excluded on Trans-Atlantic and most Latin American routes; on Asia, India and Qatar routes it gets the free bag for tickets issued on or after April 23, 2026
free_first_bag_routes.notes: Checked bag policy page, free-bag destination list: "*Excluding Basic Economy" and "^Excluding Basic Economy for tickets issued on / before April 22, 2026". Australia and New Zealand carry neither mark.

fare_name.value: Basic Economy: 1 carry-on bag and 1 personal item included; no free checked bag on most routes
fare_name.notes: Basic Economy page: "Our lowest Main Cabin fare around the world" and "You can bring 1 carry-on bag and 1 personal item on board the plane." Free-bag exceptions are in the baggage section.

seat_selection_included.value: Seat selection in advance costs a fee; otherwise a seat is assigned free at check-in, and companions on the same ticket may not sit together
seat_selection_included.notes: Basic Economy page, seats. Status-based free seats apply only to Basic Economy fares bought before May 18, 2026.

change_cancellation_policy.value: No changes. Changes or a refund are possible only within 24 hours of purchase when booked at least 7 days before departure; after that, AAdvantage members on eligible U.S.-originating trips may cancel for travel credit, for a fee
change_cancellation_policy.notes: Basic Economy page: "Basic Economy fare tickets cannot be changed,* but there are exceptions." Trips starting in Europe (except Finland, Estonia, Latvia and Lithuania) can be changed for a fee; the fee is not stated on the page.

boarding_group.notes: Basic Economy page: "Basic Economy passengers board last, typically in Group 9."

modules.title: If your flight is delayed or cancelled
modules.lede: American's conditions of carriage set out rebooking, refunds and overnight care.

rebooking.value: If your flight is cancelled or a delay could cause you to miss your connection, American rebooks you on the next American flight with available seats at no additional cost. If no American flight is available until the next day and the disruption is American's fault, it rebooks you on a partner airline.

refund.value: If your flight is cancelled or delayed by 3 or more hours (domestic) / 4 or more hours (international) and you don't accept the alternative arrangements, or none are available, American refunds the remaining ticket value and any optional fees.

overnight_care.value: If the disruption is American's fault, or you're diverted, and you don't board before 11:59 p.m. local time on your scheduled arrival day, American arranges an overnight stay or covers an approved hotel when you're away from home. For delays beyond its control, such as weather, you pay for your own hotel and meals.

modules.title: Check-in and airport cutoffs
modules.lede: Some airports have earlier check-in times (75 or 90 minutes); American lists them on its check-in page.

online_checkin.value: Online or in the app from 24 hours before departure until 45 minutes before (90 minutes for international flights).

domestic_cutoff.value: Within the U.S.: check in and check bags at least 45 minutes before scheduled departure.

international_cutoff.value: To or from destinations outside the U.S.: at least 60 minutes before scheduled departure.

modules.title: Contact and the small print
modules.lede: Use American's own pages and phone number for support and your ticket conditions.

phone_home_market.notes: Listed under 'Call us anytime' in American's conditions of carriage.

modules.title: Cabins and seating
modules.lede: Choose a seat by location and legroom, or accept a free seat assignment at check-in. Use your flight seat map because options vary with the aircraft.

seat_options.value: Flagship First/Business (1-2-1 direct aisle lie-flat suites), Premium Economy (2-3-2 38" pitch), Main Cabin Extra (extra legroom), and Main Cabin (3-3-3 / 3-3 30-31" pitch)

reserved_or_random.value: Reserve a seat in advance for free (Main Cabin, Main Cabin Extra, and Premium cabins) or for a fee on Basic Economy; complimentary seat assigned at online check-in 24h prior

family_seating.value: Children under 15 traveling with an accompanying adult on the same reservation are seated together free of charge
